name: eClinicalWorks
description: eClinicalWorks is a cloud-based electronic health record and practice-management platform. Its interoperability program supports third-party healthcare applications through FHIR APIs, SMART on FHIR provider-facing and backend service integrations, healow patient-facing FHIR integrations, scheduling, patient data access, and electronic health information export workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect an authorized eClinicalWorks or healow FHIR base URL and bearer token after provider approval and customer authorization, then let selected agents inspect discovery and content-minimized FHIR metadata under Safe or Dangerous policy.

credentialRequirements.name: EHR_FHIR_BASE_URL
credentialRequirements.label: eClinicalWorks FHIR base URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the exact HTTPS FHIR R4 base URL for the authorized eClinicalWorks, healow, sandbox, or customer tenant.

credentialRequirements.name: EHR_FHIR_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: eClinicalWorks SMART/FHIR bearer token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use an authorized, revocable token from the eClinicalWorks or healow-approved SMART/FHIR app registration and customer implementation.

capabilities.label: Read SMART/FHIR metadata
capabilities.description: Inspect tenant discovery and content-minimized metadata for allowlisted FHIR resources without exposing raw protected health information.

allowed.label: Read SMART/FHIR discovery
allowed.description: Read the connected eClinicalWorks SMART configuration and FHIR CapabilityStatement without patient chart payloads.

approvalRequired.label: Search FHIR metadata
approvalRequired.description: Search allowlisted eClinicalWorks FHIR resources with Relay-bounded query parameters and content-minimized results.

approvalRequired.label: Read FHIR resource metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact allowlisted eClinicalWorks FHIR resource through Relay's content-minimized projection.

blocked.label: Expose raw chart content
blocked.description: FHIR narratives, notes, attachments, values, addresses, telecom fields, names, identifiers, and raw records are not sent to agents.

blocked.label: Collect portal credentials
blocked.description: Relay never collects eClinicalWorks, healow, patient portal, provider portal, password, passkey, MFA, activation-code, cookie, or browser-session credentials.

blocked.label: Mutate clinical records
blocked.description: Creates, updates, deletes, bulk export, messaging, ordering, scheduling mutation, and administrative EHR actions are outside this V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Discovery runs directly. FHIR resource searches and reads require approval and return only content-minimized metadata.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected read operations run without Relay per-action approval; tenant binding, SMART/FHIR scopes, content minimization, bounds, audits, and token secrecy still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts bounded SMART/FHIR discovery and content-minimized read wrappers; tokens remain server-side.
Railway mounts bounded SMART/FHIR discovery and content-minimized read wrappers; tokens remain server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: eClinicalWorks separates provider-facing/backend FHIR integrations and healow patient-facing integrations through developer portals and provider review. Live use requires the correct portal path, app registration, callback configuration, SMART/FHIR OAuth setup, sandbox access, customer tenant authorization, and provider/customer acceptance. No provider console, account, credential, consent, Railway deployment, or live tenant validation was performed.
providerSetup.nextAction: Register Relay with the appropriate eClinicalWorks or healow developer program, configure the Railway callback, request the minimum read scopes, complete sandbox and customer non-production testing, connect an authorized FHIR base URL and token, then verify discovery, content minimization, Safe approvals, token refresh/revocation, disconnect denial, and tenant-bound audit records.

evidence.supports: eClinicalWorks describes its Platform for Open Development, FHIR APIs for third-party applications, SMART on FHIR and bulk/backend service access through the eClinicalWorks FHIR Developer Portal, patient-facing access through the healow FHIR Developer Portal, and EHI export functionality.
The eClinicalWorks FHIR developer portal is the provider-facing path for Open Development integrations.
The healow developer portal is the patient-facing developer path for eClinicalWorks/healow FHIR integrations.

The public interoperability page distinguishes provider-facing, backend/bulk, patient-facing, scheduling, patient data access, and EHI export use cases that require separate product and security decisions.
